name: Rusty Rivets
description: A boy and his best friend, a robotic dinosaur, use machine parts to create gadgets.

videos.title: Rusty's Rex Rescue
videos.overview: Rusty must come to the rescue when his friend gets trapped on top of a stack of junk in the recycling yard.

videos.title: Rusty's Park N' Fly
videos.overview: Rusty and his friends must bring Mr. Higgins' remote control plane down safely.

videos.title: Rusty Digs In
videos.overview: When the key to the city goes missing, everyone assumes Botasaur buried it.

videos.title: Rusty's Brave Cave Save
videos.overview: When Sammy gets trapped in a cave while spelunking, Rusty saves the day with a big idea.

videos.title: Rusty Dives In
videos.overview: When Ruby's tablet winds up at the bottom of a lake, Rusty dives in to retrieve it.

videos.title: Rusty's Big Top Trouble
videos.overview: When the engine fails on a circus train, Rusty must figure out how to fix it before opening night.

videos.title: Rusty Marks the Spot
videos.overview: When Rusty finds an old pirate's map, he and the gang dig up more than just treasure.

videos.title: Rusty's Bits on the Fritz
videos.overview: The bits wander into Rusty's parts replicator.

videos.title: Rusty's Bit in the Woods
videos.overview: When Crush wanders off and is lost, Rusty invents a night flyer to find him in the dark.

videos.title: Rusty's Stuffy Toughy
videos.overview: Rusty goes on a retrieval mission when Liam loses his stuffy out the train window.

videos.title: Rusty Goes Bananas
videos.overview: When the monkeys escape from their Animal Park enclosure, Rusty must find a way to lead them back.

videos.title: Rusty's Night Lights
videos.overview: The town's power goes out after Ruby takes Crush up for a plane flight

videos.title: Rusty's Ski Trip Blip
videos.overview: The group's ski trip is thwarted by a large rock pile on the way to Pliers Peak.

videos.title: Rusty and the Camp Bandit
videos.overview: Ruby and Rusty earn their camping badges.

videos.title: Rusty Rocks
videos.overview: Ruby performs at the Sprocketville Talent Show.

videos.title: Rusty's Balloon Blast
videos.overview: Liam launches a giant balloon while inside the basket and Rusty and Ruby try to bring him back down.

videos.title: Rusty's Nest Friend Forever
videos.overview: Rusty sets out to help when a rare bird builds his nest in a dangerous location.

videos.title: Rusty's Flingbot
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby build a cupcake flinging machine.

videos.title: Rusty's Penguin Problem
videos.overview: Rusty and the gang need to get some penguins to the Nature Park on the hottest day of the year.

videos.title: Rusty's Sand Castle Hassle
videos.overview: When a seagull steals Liam's elaborate sand castle plans, Rusty and Ruby must retrieve them before the contest deadline.

videos.title: Rusty's Space Bit
videos.overview: When the Bits find a satellite crashed in the scrap yard, Rusty has to find a way to get the satellite bit back home to space.

videos.title: Rusty and the Sneezing Fish
videos.overview: Rusty and the gang must move a sick fish to the Nature Park for treatment.

videos.title: Rusty's Water Works
videos.overview: Rusty fills a beach ball with water instead of air.

videos.title: Rusty's Rubbish Race
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby compete to see who can pick up the most garbage at the lake.

videos.title: Rusty in Liam Land
videos.overview: Liam wants to visit an amusement park for his birthday celebration.

videos.title: Rusty the Vacuum Kid
videos.overview: Rusty builds a big vacuum to clean up Liam's mess.

videos.title: Rusty and Captain Scoops
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby turn Sammy Scoops into an ice cream superhero in order to sell the most ice cream.

videos.title: Rusty's Creature Catcher
videos.overview: The children find the courage to search for a mysterious, mythical creature.

videos.title: Rusty and the Bit Police
videos.overview: Officer Carl needs to be in too many places at the same time, so he deputizes the Bits to help him out.

videos.title: Rusty's Jam at the Dam
videos.overview: When Rusty and his friends discover that a beaver has not been able to repair its dam, they decide to help fix the dam before it collapses.

videos.title: Rusty's Mechanical Animal
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby make Ranger Anna a robotic pet, but it goes haywire when they try to program it.

videos.title: Rusty's Spaceship
videos.overview: Rusty builds Liam a spaceship as a surprise, but instead of impressing him, it wreaks havoc on the town.

videos.title: Rusty Learns to Skate
videos.overview: Rusty builds rocket skates instead of learning how to skate, but these cut up the ice and end up stranding all his friends on ice floes.

videos.title: Rusty's Rustic Adventure
videos.overview: When Ralph (Liam's toy) goes missing in the woods, Rusty and Ruby join the hunt.

videos.title: Rusty's Botafort
videos.overview: When Rusty, Ruby and Liam build a fort that Botasaur cannot fit into, he runs away to make his own fort

videos.title: Rusty's Bull Doze
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby help Mr. Higgins fix his broken bulldozer, only to have it cause mayhem all over town.

videos.title: Rusty's Alien Invasion
videos.overview: When the comic book action figures Rusty created for Liam come alive, they behave just like their conquering characters.

videos.title: Rusty's Running Car
videos.overview: Sammy and Rusty must get back to town before the Yummy flower they picked for Sammy's sorbet turns yucky.

videos.title: Rusty Feels Peachy
videos.overview: While helping Chef Betty and Sammy compete for the Peachy Keen tasting contest, Rusty and Ruby must find a way to get them working together.

videos.title: Rusty's Monkey Mayhem
videos.overview: Ruby tries to help the monkeys at the Animal Park come up with some new performances.

videos.title: Rusty's Pet Project
videos.overview: When Botasaur gets tired from playing, Rusty builds him a bigger battery, but with it comes a lot more energy.

videos.title: Rusty Gets Stuck
videos.overview: Ruby demonstrates her newest invention, the world's strongest glue, and gets all of Sparkton Hills stuck.

videos.title: Rusty's Mysterious Mystery
videos.overview: When Officer Carl loses his lucky sculpture, Rusty and Ruby must find it and convince Officer Carl he's a great police officer.

videos.title: Rusty's Yard-Cade Game
videos.overview: Liam thinks he's only good at video games, so Rusty and Ruby turn the yard into a life-sized video game.

videos.title: Rusty's Spooky Adventure
videos.overview: Mr. Higgins makes Sparkton Hills seem haunted, but Ruby won't admit her fear until she has to face it head-on to save her friends.

videos.title: Rusty Loses the Bits
videos.overview: When the Bits escape from the Recycling Yard, Rusty and Ruby must decipher Whirly's clues to find them.

videos.title: Rusty's Plant Predicament
videos.overview: Rusty turns Botasaur into an all-terrain vehicle so he can find the stinkweeds invading town.

videos.title: Rusty's Beach Day Delay
videos.overview: Rusty turns Botasaur into a beach day gadget, but Rusty can't get to the beach to play with him because they keep stopping to help friends in need.

videos.title: Rusty's Dancing Suit
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby build a suit that dances for Mr. Higgins.

videos.title: Rusty Bee Good
videos.overview: Rusty accidentally causes bees to abandon their hive in the Recycling Yard and must lure them back home before they cause problems in town.

videos.title: Robo Rusty
videos.overview: Rusty builds a robot version of himself, so he can do two things at once.

videos.title: Rusty's Kitty Catastrophe
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby build a robotic buddy for Botasaur, a Kittybot, but Botasaur accidentally scares her away.

videos.title: Ruby's Comet Adventure
videos.overview: Ruby wants to see a comet fly by, and Rusty will do everything in his power to make sure his friend's wish comes true!

videos.title: Rusty's Messy Mishap
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby race to fix a leaking underwater oil pipeline before it pollutes the lake and makes it uninhabitable.

videos.title: Rustys Mobile Rivet Lab
videos.overview: When Ranger Anna crash lands her planes in the distant savannah, Rusty and Ruby realize they need a new vehicle that can not only travel the distance, but aid them in their builds. Thus, the Mobile Rivet Lab is born!

videos.title: Rusty's Piggy Bank Heist
videos.overview: Rusty forgets the code to his robotic piggy bank, activating its self-defense mode and turning it into a runaway robotic boar.

videos.title: Rusty's Whale of a Problem
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby must save a baby whale that's been beached during a storm and reunite it with her family.

videos.title: Rusty's Monkey Business
videos.overview: When Ranger Anna gets stuck in a tree while observing monkeys, Rusty and Ruby make a monkey of their own to save her... Botarilla!

videos.title: Frankie's Botasaur
videos.overview: New neighbor Frankie Fritz bot-naps Botasaur, making Rusty and Ruby go on a chase to get their friend back.

videos.title: Rusty's Mega Stacker
videos.overview: Rusty builds a machine that makes and stacks sand blocks, to help Liam build a giant sandcastle.

videos.title: Fix It 500
videos.overview: Frankie Fritz challenges Rusty and Ruby to a multistage race around Sparkton Hills, with the Mobile Rivet Lab as the stakes.

videos.title: Ice Ice Rusty
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby try to save the school's art fair from being frozen over by Frankie Fritz and his modified Skunk-bot.

videos.title: Rusty vs. the Robo-Squirrel
videos.overview: The robotic squirrel Rusty made to keep Bytes occupied goes rogue and swipes all the nuts and bolts from things all over town and causing things to fall apart.

videos.title: Rusty's Day of the Drones
videos.overview: Rusty's Day of the Drones  Frankie Fritz uses a handful of homemade drones to swipe Rusty and Ruby's mega battery.

videos.title: Rusty and the Pirates of Sparkton Hills
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby set off on their pirate ship in a hunt for a buried treasure.

videos.title: Rusty and the Mouse Problem
videos.overview: When Frankie's robo-mouse accidentally gets copied dozens of times, it is up to Rusty and Ruby to round up the little critters before they take over Sparkton Hills.

videos.title: Rusty and the Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: When Mr. Higgins accidentally knocks the power out all over town, Rusty has to save Ruby's surprise birthday party.

videos.title: Rusty's Ninja Fish Rescue
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby try to rescue Ninja Fish's kids, who are trapped inside a shipwreck by a giant octopus.

videos.title: Rusty's Relaxing Recliner
videos.overview: Rusty builds his Mom the ultimate relaxing chair, but whenever it hears any noise, it runs away and raises high into the sky.

videos.title: Rusty and the Stinky Situation
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby try to save the Wake Up and Smell the Roses Contest.

videos.title: Rusty's Runaway Sled
videos.overview: Bytes and some of the Bits accidentally go on a wild ride in a runaway sled.

videos.title: Rusty's Sky Pie Delivery
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby make Officer Carl a giant blueberry pie.

videos.title: Rusty's Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Rusty, Ruby and TigerBot help a stranded baby giraffe in the desert.

videos.title: Rusty and the S'mores Snatcher
videos.overview: Rusty, Ruby and Tigerbot must save Botasaur when he runs off into the jungle.

videos.title: Rusty's Sick Fix
videos.overview: The bots catch a virus and wreak havoc with their aggressive sneezes.

videos.title: Rusty's Journey to the Center of Sparkton Hills
videos.overview: Bytes accidentally tunnels his way into a mine.

videos.title: Rusty's Walk on the Small Side
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby accidentally shrink down with Rusty's latest invention, then must fight their way across the yard to size themselves back up.

videos.title: Liam Gets Birdnapped
videos.overview: After a giant mama bird adopts Liam, Rusty and Ruby must rescue him.

videos.title: Super Rusty vs. Super Villain Bot
videos.overview: Wanting to be a hero like Rusty, Frankie creates a Super Villian Bot and programs it to make him look like a hero too.

videos.title: Rusty in Space
videos.overview: When aliens crash on Earth, Rusty and Ruby must help them get back home in time for the most important alien holiday of the year!

videos.title: Rusty and the Heroic Helpers
videos.overview: Rusty transforms some objects to some of the coolest contraptions with the help of his best friend.

videos.title: Rusty Saves Christmas
videos.overview: When the conveyor belt Santa uses to load gifts from his workshop into his gigantic toy bag breaks, Rusty, Ruby, and Liam head to the North Pole to fix it. Frankie stows away to find the present he really wants for Christmas.

videos.title: Rusty and the Temple of Boom
videos.overview: When Liam gets trapped inside an ancient elephant temple, Rusty and Ruby enlist the bots to breach the temple and find him. Ultimately, they undertake the recue with a new creature, Elephantbot!

videos.title: Rusty's Bubble Trouble
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby must a find a way to pop the mega bubbles that have scooped up Bytes and Mrs. Rivets before they float up into space!

videos.title: Rusty's Runaway Sub
videos.overview: Liam and Emily accidentally set the Rivet Sub on a course out to sea!

videos.title: Rusty's Roller Rescue
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby make rollerskates for Botasaur, but he doesn't know how to stop and goes on a wild ride!

videos.title: Knight Time for Rusty
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby build Liam a castle and a powerful magnetic scepter, so he can play king.

videos.title: Rusty's Elephant Escape
videos.overview: When Elephant Bot goes to visit the new baby elephant at the animal park, the baby runs off.

videos.title: Rusty and the Flying Skunk
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby must help Frankie when he attaches a large propeller to Frankford.

videos.title: Rusty and the Floating School
videos.overview: When Frankie accidentally levitates the school, Rusty and Ruby have to find a way to get it - and everyone inside - back on the ground.

videos.title: Rusty vs. Mega Frankford
videos.overview: Frankie builds a giant Frankford robot, but the robot's power source overheats, threatening to stink up the town.

videos.title: Rusty's Arctic Adventure
videos.overview: When Orbit crashes in the Arctic, it's up to Rusty and Ruby to get him back into space.

videos.title: Super Liam
videos.overview: When Liam doesn't take the time to learn how the new superhero suit Rusty and Ruby make for him works, disaster ensues.

videos.title: Secret Agent Rusty
videos.overview: When Frankie breaks into the Rivet Lab and takes control, Rusty and Ruby have to be "secret agent" sneaky to stop him.

videos.title: Moon Walkin' Rusty
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby's trip to the moon is complicated when Frankie Fritz stows away!

videos.title: Rusty's Dino Island
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby discover an island where dinosaurs still exist, but they won't much longer unless they can stop the island's volcano from erupting!

videos.title: Rusty's Tiny Adventure
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby discover an island where dinosaurs still exist, but they won't much longer unless they can stop the island's volcano from erupting!

videos.title: Rusty's Raptor Race
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby build a raptor of their own to rescue Frankie Fritz on Dino Island!

videos.title: Rusty's Triceratops
videos.overview: When Brawny gets stuck in quicksand, Rusty and Ruby need to build something super strong to pull him out.

videos.title: Frankie's Super Shoes
videos.overview: Frankie's souped-up shoes malfunction during the basketball championship game and Rusty and Ruby need a slam dunk of an idea to save him.

videos.title: Rusty's Rapid Ralph Return
videos.overview: Liam forgets to bring his favorite toy on vacation so Rusty and Ruby build a jet to catch up to his plane.

videos.title: Rusty and the Search for Ozzy
Liam's Caterpillar Calamity
videos.overview: Liam, Rusty, and Ruby vow to return a caterpillar to its home, at the tippy top of the tallest tree in the jungle!

videos.title: Rusty's Birthday Round-Up
videos.overview: When Frankie pilfers Liam's new robotic pony, Cowboy Botasaur helps get it back.

videos.title: Rusty's Meteor Madness
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby need Botasaur's help to stop falling meteors that threaten to destroy Dino Island.

videos.title: Rusty's Dino for a Day
videos.overview: Frankie runs amok in a dino mech suit and causes problems all over Dino Island.

videos.title: Rusty and Ruby on the Fritz
Rusty's Franken Monster Truck
videos.overview: When Shaz's pet blob grows to enormous proportions, Rusty and Ruby have to shrink it back down before it devours the whole town.

videos.title: Rusty's Adventures in Blobbo Sitting
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby turn Frankford into Franken Monster Truck to help round up a family of wayward elephants.

videos.title: Rusty's Raptor Crossing
videos.overview: Steam causes Dino Island chasm to expand, separating baby raptors from their mama.

videos.title: Rusty's Dinosaur Snow Day
videos.overview: When Frankasaurus takes Rusty's snow machine, they must stop him before he freezes all of Dino Island.

videos.title: Rusty's Floating Adventure
videos.overview: Liam's favourite toy sails into a storm drain and out to sea on a paper boat.

videos.title: Rusty's Hoppy Day
videos.overview: Liam needs Rusty, Ruby and Botasaur to help him catch frogs and return them to the pond.

videos.title: Ozzy's Snooze Cruise
videos.overview: Frankasaurus mistakes Ozzy for a snoring dinosaur and accidentally sets him adrift in a crate.

videos.title: Rusty and the Flying Pirate Monkeys
videos.overview: Rascally monkeys take Rusty's pirate ship on an aerial joy ride with the Bits trapped on board!

videos.title: Rusty's Delivery Day
videos.overview: Rusty and Ruby help Mr. Higgins deliver packages. It's a race against the clock to deliver the most important package of all.

videos.title: Rusty's Pendant Problem
videos.overview: Oliver needs Rusty and Ruby's help to find Ozzy's birthday gift.

videos.title: Rusty's Giant Toy Trouble
videos.overview: Emily and Liam get swept up by a giant toy. Rusty and Ruby must figure out how to stop it.

videos.title: Frankie's Fritz Bits
videos.overview: Frankie decides he wants Bits of his own, but Frankie's Fritz Bitz prove to be more trouble than they're worth.

videos.title: Rusty's Ice Cream Day Disaster
videos.overview: When Sammy gets trapped in his frozen-over ice cream shop, Rusty, Ruby, and Liam must find a way to free him and save Sundae Funday.

videos.title: Whole Lava Trouble
videos.overview: With Steggie's help, Rusty and Ruby deposit lava back into the volcano to save The O Bros' camp.

videos.title: Rusty's Missing Mom Adventure
videos.overview: When Rusty brings his mom to Dino Island for a tour, Frankasaurus decides he wants to give her a tour of his own.
